code:
A Configuration Item (CI) is:
  infrastructure, a service, or an application
  whose STATE, CONFIGURATION, and RELATIONSHIPS
  need tracking to deliver and manage services

Examples:
  a physical application server
  a specific installed application
  a network switch
  a database instance
caption: The test is "does tracking this matter for services," not "is this a thing."

eyebrow: A CI is not a work record
code:
Incident record (task table)        CI record (cmdb_ci table)
  number: INC0010042                  name: WEB-APP-SRV-04
  short_description: "site down"      ip_address: 10.20.4.17
  cmdb_ci: [reference]  ------------->  operational_status: Operational

The Incident REFERENCES the CI.
The Incident is not itself a CI.
caption: Closing the Incident never deletes or changes the CI it pointed to.
